C1132.title: Major Dubai Heist Used AI Voice Cloning
C1132.summary: Dubai investigators claim AI voice cloning was used in a major heist in the country, warning the public to beware of criminals exploiting the technology for fraud. The case shows AI voice cloning has been used in serious crime, with attackers leveraging synthesized speech to carry out a robbery.
